description.en: Sets the player's team manager (coach) by ID, e.g. "iim0002" (by the command's name; the ID has the form of an item ID). The ID is hashed and passed to the team routine.

The routine's result, true once set; false if the ID is missing.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: A new manager for the team (real usage, from ev42120900.nut)
